title: Pricing the Inevitable
text: 40-year-old walks asks $250,000 whole life insurance. net premium $2,109.46 year. number break-even average, hides bet: price policy still loses money one time three, everyone dies early loss. much charge 95% sure losing money? table insurance works. project builds engine behind first principles, 19 insurance annuity products, puts desk can use.

title: Pricing the Inevitable
text: Quote Desk Shiny pricing desk style 1950s insurance office: 🖋 quote letter: choose applicant (age, underwriting class), plan payment frequency; desk types quote premium, chance claim, chance policy loses money premium needed 95% confidence. Print , file session’s quote book. 🎲 Risk Lab: four premium principles side side, probability loss premium rises, 1,000 simulated portfolios checking normal approximation. ⏳ Mortality Lab: Makeham, Gompertz, de Moivre, constant force Weibull, three ways spreading deaths within year. 🗄 Product Shelf: 19 products age, full distribution one’s present value. ⚖ Natural Hedge: mix annuities life insurance cancels mortality shock. 🔖 Beat Underwriter: guess premium random applicant get stamped APPROVED, REFERRED DECLINED. desk works →

title: Pricing the Inevitable
text: Hand calculations: three-year life worked paper (q = 0.1, 0.2, 1 10%) insurance, annuities, premiums premium refunds. Identities: = 1 − d ä; endowment = term + pure endowment; increasing + decreasing term = (n + 1) × term; Var(Y) = Var(Z)/d²; UDD m-thly formula equals exact UDD sum; key relations deferred, guaranteed term annuities. Independent rebuilds: Excel cent, Python 1e-14, SQL model’s probabilities loss. Automation: R CMD check every test every push (see runs).

title: Pricing the Inevitable
text: Getting started.
code: # install.packages("devtools") devtools::install_github("soodpratham10/pricing-the-inevitable") library(inevitable)  m <- mortality_law()                                   # the project's Gompertz-Makeham law q <- class_q_path(m, 40, "Smoker")                     # a newly underwritten 40-year-old smoker net_premium("term", q, i = 0.045, S = 250000, n = 20, t = 20) portfolio_premium("whole_life", q_path(m, 40), 0.045, S = 250000, N = 1000) natural_hedge(m)$ratio
